---
name: Documentation improvement
about: Suggest a correction or clarification to public documentation
title: "docs: "
labels: documentation
---

## What should change?

Link the page and quote or describe the specific text.

## Why?

Explain the reader problem, factual correction, or missing context. Do not include
credentials or private information.

## Governance tier

Is this a governance-lite correction (typo, formatting, link, or clarification with no
change to product claims or behavior)? If not, describe the governed change it needs.
